summary: This script sets up configuration variables for running a Joomla application in Docker containers. It defines names, versions, and connection details for the Joomla web server, MySQL database, and Docker containers that will be launched together.

explanations.1: CONTAINER_PREFIX is a naming convention used to identify Docker containers belonging to this Joomla project, making them easy to find and manage later.
explanations.6: MYSQL_PORT specifies which port number the MySQL database will listen on inside its container; 3306 is the standard default MySQL port.
explanations.9: WEB_PORT assigns which port on your local machine will forward traffic to the Joomla web server running in Docker; 8080 means you'll access Joomla at localhost:8080.
